# RetroWin

> A macOS application that brings back the classic Windows taskbar experience. RetroWin recreates the look and feel of Windows 98, Windows XP, Windows 7, and Windows 10 taskbars on macOS with pixel-perfect retro UI.

## Core Features
- Multiple retro themes: Windows 98, Windows XP, Windows 7, and Windows 10, with pixel-perfect classic UI details.
- Multi-monitor support: independent taskbar on each display, freely configurable.
- Window management: real-time app tracking, activation, minimization, merge/expand modes, and window hover preview.
- Taskbar pinning: pin apps to the taskbar, drag to reorder, persistent even when closed.
- Classic Start Menu: theme-specific layouts with pinnable programs, search, and quick access to system functions.
- System tray: input method indicator, volume control, clock, and custom app tray icons.
- Power menu: Sleep, Restart, Shut Down, Lock Screen, and Log Off with theme-matching dialogs.
- Desktop customization: auto-hide taskbar, 50% to 200% scaling for any display.
- Auto-update via Sparkle.
- Multi-language: English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Français.

## Technical Details
- Built with SwiftUI and AppKit for native macOS performance.
- Requires macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) or later.
- Supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs.

## Pricing
- Free version: core features including themes, window tracking, start menu, system tray, and multi-language support.
- Pro version (¥8.8 one-time): auto-hide, scaling, follow window mode, merge/expand windows, window title display, hover preview, and disable auto-update.
